name: update_deployment
description: Move a deployment to its next state. It only moves forward: requested, approved, running, then verified or failed; a verified or failed one can be rolled_back. One that is not running yet can be rejected, by whoever requested it or could approve it. Approving is refused where a person approves deployments of the product. Returns the deployment. Refusals: denied:, bad_transition: (not the next state), evidence: (verified needs it).

state.description: approved, rejected, running, verified, failed or rolled_back.

evidence.description: With verified: the health and smoke-test output. Required.
